result.summary: Deprecates the `replaceable` argument across ten transaction and PSBT creation and modification RPCs (`createrawtransaction`, `createpsbt`, `fundrawtransaction`, `walletcreatefundedpsbt`, `send`, `sendtoaddress`, `sendmany`, `sendall`, `bumpfee`, and `psbtbumpfee`). Supplying this argument now returns an `RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED` error unless the node is started with `-deprecatedrpc=bip125`. It also updates functional tests to avoid passing the argument and documents the deprecation in the release notes.
result.problem: Since Bitcoin Core v28 enabled full-RBF by default, transactions are replaceable across the network regardless of BIP 125 opt-in sequence signaling. Offering an explicit `replaceable` argument across wallet and raw transaction RPCs is redundant and clutters the RPC interface.
evidence: PR description: "This builds upon the existing issue of removing the option for users to signal replaceability because fullrbf is the default policy and prevalent in the network (since bitcoin core v28 was released in late 2024) that makes every transaction replaceable by default, making this user option unnecessary."
Linked issue #32661: "wallet, node: Redundant opt-in RBF wallet config and RPC parameters"

enables: Complete removal of the `replaceable` RPC argument and associated opt-in RBF signaling logic in a future major release (#32661).

result.scope_notes: Follows the standard RPC deprecation pattern using `IsDeprecatedRPCEnabled` and `rpcEnableDeprecated` checks; touches RPC argument handlers in `spend.cpp` and `rawtransaction.cpp` alongside test adjustments.
result.changed_since_previous: Functional test coverage was significantly expanded in `test/functional/wallet_deprecated_rbf.py` to cover raw transaction, PSBT, and send RPCs under both default and deprecated startup configurations, while existing tests were updated to omit explicit `replaceable` parameters.
result.card: Deprecates the replaceable argument across ten transaction and PSBT creation and modification RPCs, throwing an RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED error unless the node is started with -deprecatedrpc=bip125. Because full-RBF has been the default network policy since Bitcoin Core v28, transactions are replaceable regardless of BIP 125 opt-in sequence numbers, making the parameter redundant. This addresses issue 32661 and prepares the RPC interface for the argument's complete removal in a future release.

risk.why: Mistakes in RPC argument handling or deprecation checks could break transaction creation for external scripts and wallet integrations.
